addon.ctf-countdown.meta.name: CTF Countdown
addon.ctf-countdown.meta.description: Adds a sidebar tab with a live countdown to when the event ends. End time and title are configurable from the gear button.
addon.ctf-countdown.no_end_time: No end time has been set yet - ask an admin to configure one from the gear button.
addon.ctf-countdown.config.end_time_help: Shown in each player's own local time zone. Leave empty to hide the countdown until you set one.
